scope: scripts/qualify_followup_checks.py (all 16 stages) on Debug builds of ed8a84e3's src (runner at the 'Create the test DB' commit) on owned scratch projects and PLCSIM instances: tia_capabilities workerVersion and physical_plc; a plain tia_attach behind a busy client; ProjectLocked with a second Portal and tia_session_status portals; an exited client in attachedSessions; hmi_inspect page and early target.kind refusals (plain scratch and an HmiSeeder unified-pc baseline); repeated property names refused on sim_write and change_prepare with the session kept; QueueTimeout for a second call during a 47 s change_apply; sim_write_signals refusing both spellings of one tag in a batch on a provisioned running instance (user-authorized first-use trust); simulation_download ticketState unusable, reusable (released instance) and spent (SimulationCredentialRequired) with the spent ticket's retry refused; SimulationRegistrationsPresent with details and tia_detach plcsimRegistrations; the stale change-directory sweep removing only an aged prepared change; LoadableProvider on an added CPU 1518; HmiPreservationUnavailable with its remediation.
limitations: The UMC global-user login, UmacLoginRejected and host_build_identity from an installed package are not part of this run.

A refused password question in the offline simulation_download still leaves TIA's Portal disposed (the worker throws from the download callback); tia_detach now recovers the session, the decline itself is open in docs/TODO.md.
